note.welcome.title: Torn notebook page
body: If you can read this, you fell too. Don't panic. Panic is loud.
I have been down here three days (I think). The halls go on, but not forever. There is a way out. A real one.

The exits are numbered. EXIT 1, EXIT 2... they open onto brick. Only EXIT 0 is real. Zero means a clean shutdown. It's behind the gate at the west end of the long hall. The gate is dead. It needs power.
The power is past the MAINTENANCE door. Find the key first.

note.cooler.title: Sticky note on the cooler
body: LOCKER 3 code:
(the year we got the good coffee machine)
- Dale

note.tenant.title: Note taped by the window
body: DON'T RUN.
The tall one in there is not a person. It wears a light where a face should be. I call it the Fixture.
It can't see while it sleeps. It listens. Running feet, splashing, slammed switches. Walk, and it stays asleep.
If it wakes, it goes to the noise and looks around. Get out of its light and keep walking. It gives up. Eventually.

note.office.title: Interoffice memo
body: TO: All Maintenance Staff
RE: Keys
The MAINTENANCE door key must be returned to Desk 4 at the end of each shift. Do not take the key home. There is no home.
Reminder: the halls are cleaned nightly. Do not be in the halls at night.
- Facilities

note.locker.title: Hand-drawn map
body: START: the room with the hole in the ceiling.
LONG HALL runs east-west. EXIT 0 is behind the gate at its west end.
DEAD OFFICE: south of the pillar room. Desk 4 has the key. Bring a light.
MAINTENANCE door: east end of the south hall.
Past it: breaker room north. Pipes east. Flood room south.
The Fixture's room has a back door into the corridor. WALK.

note.repair.title: Grease-stained page
body: Found why the gate is dead. The main box in the breaker room blew its 30A fuse.
To fix it: wrench to take the cover off, new fuse in, bolt the cover back on.
Spare fuses are in the flood room, on the far shelf. The water is safe as long as PUMP 2 stays OFF.
Then B4 for the gate. It will be LOUD. Be ready to walk away. Not run. Walk fast.

note.breaker.title: Panel label, hand-written
body: B1 - Office lighting
B2 - Hall lighting. Leave it ON. Things come out in the dark.
B3 - Pump 2. NEVER WHILE FLOODED!!!
B4 - Gate / east exit. Needs the main box.

note.flood.title: Wet page
body: On day one I switched on B3 to drain this room. The water started to sing. I didn't go in.
The mop did. It is still smoking a little.
Leave the pump off.
